# RichText.online

> RichText.online is a free, browser-based rich text (WYSIWYG) editor. It needs no sign-up and no installation. Documents are saved automatically in the visitor's own browser; signing in with Google is optional and only adds saving documents to an account.

What it does: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, headings H1-H6, lists, text and background colour, fonts and sizes, links, images, YouTube and Vimeo embeds, tables, find and replace, a Markdown mode with live preview, source HTML view, dark mode, fullscreen, version history on the device, and export as HTML or PDF (browser print). A document can be shared as a link that contains the document itself, with a GitHub Gist as an option for very long documents. The editor can also be embedded in other websites with one script tag.

## Pages

- [Editor (English)](https://richtext.online/): the editor and the full feature list, how-to guide, use cases and FAQ
- [Embedding guide](https://richtext.online/embed-example.html): how to add the editor to another website (English)
- [Japanese](https://richtext.online/ja/), [French](https://richtext.online/fr/), [Spanish](https://richtext.online/es/), [Arabic](https://richtext.online/ar/), [Portuguese](https://richtext.online/pt/), [Russian](https://richtext.online/ru/): the same editor and content in each language (machine translated)

## Facts

- Price: free. No account is needed to use the editor.
- Storage: content stays in the visitor's browser (local storage) unless they choose to share it or save it to their Google-linked account.
- Source code: https://github.com/souravkhoso1/wysiwyg-editor
